concerns.text: Task T002 is scheduled before its producer T003. T002 modifies and tests `code/graph_generator.py`, which is created in T003. This creates a consumer‑before‑producer ordering violation.

Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but performs foundational project scaffolding (directory creation, requirement file generation) that is shared state. Running it in parallel with other tasks could cause race conditions, so the `[P]` tag is unsafe.
Task T002 is also marked `[P]` but edits `code/graph_generator.py`, a file produced by T003. Parallel execution with T003 would lead to write‑conflict, making the `[P]` designation unsafe.
